outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official outcome is both_fail: parallel solution_passed is false and serial solution_passed is false. The attempts still differ materially. Parallel had a multi-agent shared-source overwrite around fuzzsim/afl_fuzzer.py, ended with unknown_agent_error, collected zero requirement patches, and failed afl_outputs. Serial completed the required patch workflow, passed afl_outputs, and only failed the remaining AFL class/determinism API tests. The retained pattern explains the worse parallel delivery and AFL-output state, not an official pass/fail split.
